4f508b55b61fd2b21cc4.en: On the 5th, the Newtalk News Continental Committee, together with the Sea Foundation, specially invited Guan Jianzhong, the person in charge of Lion Film and Television, to express the government's concern about the malicious harassment and intimidation he suffered due to the introduction and promotion of the documentary "State Organ", and to learn more about his latest situation and needs. Liang Wenjie, deputy head of the Land Commission, said that he admired Guan Jianzhong's courage in the face of repression and continued to stand up. The government will not tolerate any acts of coercion, and insists on defending the freedom of expression of the people of the country and the determination to pursue the protection of human rights. Regardless of the coercion, the government will stand with the parties concerned to provide the most immediate and extended assistance to the victims of cross-border repression, and safeguard the personal safety and legitimate rights and interests of the country. Guan Jianzhong pointed out that the CCP's intimidation and harassment is essentially a psychological warfare, which attempts to create social fear and create a chilling effect. He stressed that the public must stick to the psychological defense.
